subject: documents.records

entries.definition: A governed index record for a shared document or link, classified by document type and audience and related through exact resource identities to the records that reference it.

A document in a restricted workspace collection that remains governed and served in place and is excluded from the shared document index and harness projections, including its content and provider page identities.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable document-index and private-workspace boundary meaning only; it does not inspect private collections, expose their content, or grant provider access.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
